what: Two answers of shared/taskStatus.ts that move into the core: the i18n KEY a task state, effort or priority is announced with (null where nothing is announced), and how far a parent’s subtasks are. Measured from the TypeScript before the port.
why: Both surfaces announce the same words for the same state, and a frontend that is not JavaScript has to announce them too. The core answers with the KEY, never the sentence (DESIGN §4.5 a); the surface renders it. The keys are published as one table the surface reads once at install, because the phone would otherwise cross the native bridge once per chip.
writtenBy: src/intl/taskStatus.measure.test.ts — a one-off, run once and deleted; the progress cases mirror src/intl/taskStatus.test.ts plus the rows the port needs (only-cancelled children, several parents at once, an absent parent row).

whereItLives.note: Inside cal-core, like taskGrouping.json and taskDay.json: twelve adapter repositories compile cal-core, and an include_str! reaching out of the crate would break the day it moves.

notInThisTable.statusMarker: the glyphs ○ ◐ ● ⊘ stay on the surface: the core answers a state, each surface picks its characters (an e-ink display plausibly wants others)
notInThisTable.priorityMarker: the glyphs ! !! !!! and ★ stay on the surface, for the same reason
notInThisTable.prioritySuffix_effortSuffix_subtaskProgr: wording through t — the surface’s; they read the keys and counts from this table
notInThisTable.subtaskParentTitle: a lookup of the parent’s title, not a decision
notInThisTable.priorityRank_isImportantPriority_normalP: already in the core (cal_core::task_priority), already doors

shape.keys: status: every TaskStatus → key; effort: every TaskEffort → key or null; priority: per PriorityScale, every TaskPriority → key or null
shape.baseTask: the Task every progress case starts from; a case’s `tasks` entries are overrides merged over it
shape.progress: {tasks, parents} → parent id → {done, total} or null. done = completed direct children; total = direct children that are not cancelled; null when total is 0.

progress.name: no-children-is-null
progress.note: A parent with no children at all, and a task that is nobody’s child.

progress.name: counts-completed-and-drops-cancelled-from-the-total
progress.note: Four children, one cancelled: the fraction reflects what is left to do. in_progress is not done.

progress.name: direct-children-only
progress.note: A grandchild counts for its own parent, not for the grandparent.

progress.name: only-cancelled-children-is-null
progress.note: Nothing left to do and nothing done: no fraction to speak.

progress.name: several-parents-in-one-ask
progress.note: The views ask per row; the core answers every parent at once.

progress.name: children-count-even-when-the-parent-row-is-absent
progress.note: The count is by parent_id; whether the parent itself is in the list does not matter.
